facts.fact: WHO Togo's 2024 annual report states that Togo uses DHIS2 to collect health data in all districts and that, despite good command of the tools and a working quality-control system, completeness rates remain unstable: 91% in 2017, a peak of 96.5% in 2018, then a fall to 89.2% in 2021; it gives no numerator or denominator and does not say which facilities report or where the data is keyed.

WHO Togo reports that in 2024, through the Benin-Burkina Faso-Niger-Togo (BBNT) initiative supported by WHO and the Global Fund, Togo strengthened its capacity to analyse and use the data extracted from DHIS2 on malaria, tuberculosis and HIV, hepatitis and STIs, the analysis leading to a roadmap of corrective measures; it gives no counts of staff or facilities.
